Why Extracellular `ENPP1` Defeated Intracellular Competitors (`WO-001`)

1. Extracellular Ectoenzyme Accessibility (No Cytosolic Efflux Barrier)
Unlike `PTPN2` and `ADAR1`, `ENPP1` acts on the outer tumor plasma membrane (`TPSA = 111.79 Å²`), avoiding intracellular P-gp efflux and sparing healthy non-cGAMP-producing tissues.
2. Elimination of `TREX1` Systemic Interferonopathy (`L-001`, `DEC-001`)
Hypex debate `M-002` and `WO-002` human genetics proved that systemic `TREX1` inhibition mimics Aicardi-Goutières syndrome (`PMID:16845398`), whereas `ENPP1` cleavage blockade is strictly conditional on tumor chromosomal instability (CIN) producing extracellular 2′,3′-cGAMP.
